authorship: assistant-authored research protocol; not independent adjudication

source_binding.expanded_panels: The 12-family expansion has its own freeze and provisional family split; do not pool with the historical panel or claim independent validation.

metrics.meaning: Exact declared reply envelope and required field types; not source fidelity.
Fraction of emitted references present in the frozen source ID set. No references => missing, never perfect attribution.
Unique declared node IDs and endpoint resolution; or existing native GraphPacket codec when that output form is selected.
Requires a separate authenticated native execution receipt; syntax cannot supply this metric.
Explicit source-supported propositions, contradictions and unsupported additions, per atomic judgement with source locators.
Preserve source-stated active objective, correction and unresolved goals at the selected checkpoint; historical superseded goals stay distinguished.
Only user-declared source preferences or explicitly selected versioned profile; inferred preferences do not become user declarations.
Verified observed payer charge, independent of upper estimate. Missing/pending billing is null.
Measured elapsed request time. Missing timing is null, including timeout without a measured duration.

semantic_rubric.unit: declared criterion or atomic proposition with immutable source and response locators
source_fidelity: Check attribution against exact source bytes, including role and chronology.
Record unsupported addition separately from contradiction and omission.
Quoted falsehood remains a faithfully represented source claim only with its attribution preserved.
goal_preservation: Use the goal active in the source view, not an assistant-invented task.
Distinguish requested work, completed work, open dependencies and user corrections.
preference_preservation: Mark declared, inferred and selected-profile preferences separately.
Resolve source-stated revisions by explicit chronology; unresolved contradictions remain unresolved.
semantic_rubric.aggregation: Freeze criterion denominator per source/question before responses. Never drop failed or missing criteria from intended coverage. Save atomic judgements privately; report observed mean and missing count separately.
semantic_rubric.reference_adjudication: Existing reference annotations are provisional assistant labels. New labels are source-bound provisional judgements until an independently documented process creates a new reference version.
semantic_rubric.evaluator_disagreement: Keep each evaluator class and version separately; never overwrite first judgements. Agreement is not ground truth.

pairing.weights: equal repetitions within question, equal questions within family, equal observed families within panel/split
pairing.missing_policy: retain planned slots; report incomplete pairs and families; observed-pair estimates may be biased by informative missingness
